ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle ADE$, where point $E$ is on $BC$. It is known that $\angle B = \angle D$, $\angle DAB = \angle EAC$. Thus, $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle ADE$. If $AC \parallel DE$ and $\angle AEC = 45^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC \parallel DE$,\\
$\therefore \angle AED = \angle EAC$,\\
Since $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle ADE$,\\
$\therefore \angle AED = \angle C$,\\
$\therefore \angle EAC = \angle C$,\\
Given that $\angle AEC = 45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle C = (180^\circ - 45^\circ) \div 2 = 67.5^\circ$,\\
Hence, the measure of $\angle C$ is $\boxed{67.5^\circ}$.

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle ADE$, where point $E$ is on $BC$, it is known that $\angle B = \angle D$ and $\angle DAB = \angle EAC$. Thus, $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle ADE$. If $AC \parallel DE$ and $\angle AEC = 45^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC \parallel DE$,\\ $\therefore \angle AED = \angle EAC$,\\ Since $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle ADE$,\\ $\therefore \angle AED = \angle C$,\\ $\therefore \angle EAC = \angle C$,\\ Given that $\angle AEC = 45^\circ$,\\ $\therefore \angle C = (180^\circ - 45^\circ) \div 2 = 67.5^\circ$,\\ Hence, the measure of $\angle C$ is $\boxed{67.5^\circ}$.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, B, E, C are on the same straight line, and E is located on BC; A is at the upper right, D is at the upper left; AB, AE, AC, AD, DE are connected, among which AC is parallel to DE, and triangle AEC is located inside triangle ABC. Reasoning: It is known that triangle ABC and triangle ADE are similar, with the correspondence A↔A, B↔D, C↔E, so angle C of triangle ABC equals angle AED of triangle ADE, that is, ∠C = ∠AED. Also because AC ∥ DE, taking AE as the transversal, ∠AED equals ∠EAC. Therefore ∠C = ∠EAC. Since E is on BC, ∠ACE is exactly ∠C of triangle ABC. Thus, in triangle AEC, ∠EAC = ∠ACE = ∠C, and ∠AEC = 45°. From the sum of the interior angles of a triangle, 2∠C + 45° = 180°, so ∠C = (180° - 45°) / 2 = 67.5°.
